note: The holder kept an open versioned transaction (main's branch row locked) when the host-only link was unplugged and its client process died. Without server-side keepalive or idle-in-transaction timeouts the server only notices a dead client when TCP gives up; the drill records how long main stayed locked and whether the owner role could recover with pg_terminate_backend.
